method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a completely blank ruled sheet -- an honest zero, not a gap. Cover line 1 CUMULATIVE is a slashed-zero glyph (Zero-glyph ruling: = 0); the LAST and THIS cells on line 1 are left empty. Generation-1 Carr Printing form: NO printed schedule total on Form A, so schedule_total is null and the cover line is the only anchor. Line 2 (<=$50 aggregate) cumulative is also a slashed zero and is never itemized.

expenditures.detail: One inked row on Form B, 375.00, equals cover line 3 in ALL THREE columns: LAST (dark ink 375.00), THIS (a faint/light copy of 375.00) and CUMULATIVE (a slashed zero struck through, then a faint 375.00). The three scopes therefore coincide on this filing; recorded as cumulative. Generation-1 form prints no schedule total (schedule_total null).

gates.page_subtotal: Gen-1 form prints NO schedule total on either sheet -- no page-subtotal gate exists. Gated against the cover instead: p2 rows sum 0 = cover line 1 cum (slashed zero); p3 rows sum 375.00 = cover line 3 (all three columns).
gates.row_count: p2: ~40 ruled writing lines, ZERO inked -- 0 rows emitted. p3: ~40 ruled lines, exactly 1 inked (top line) -- 1 row emitted; counted by eye against the ink (the Gen-1 sheet is ruled lines, not a boxed grid).
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first(=only) row amount box crop at 600 dpi renders '375.^00'; the control crop one row-pitch below renders EMPTY (blank ruled line).
gates.balance_chain: Does NOT close: cover line 4 (balance at end) cumulative is a slashed zero = 0, but contributions cum 0 - expenses cum 375.00 = -375.00. The filer reported 375.00 of expense with zero contributions and a zero ending balance; the form has no self-funding line. Retained verbatim, not adjusted -- this is the filer's own arithmetic.

escalation_note: p1 line-3 anchor row re-rendered at 600 dpi (to separate the dark LAST 375.00 from the faint THIS/CUM copies and confirm the struck zero); p3 row-1 amount cell + control at 600 dpi.
